description: Pitch/spacing rule values per interconnect method (IXN.b spacing, IXN.e pitch). These are the bump-to-bump rules that moved out of the interposer PDK (Padc.b/Padc.e, Padb.b/Padb.e). Mirror of interconnect_methods.json pitch_rules for the standalone bump_pitch.drc deck; the manifest is the source of truth.
